unlisted_practices: Transforming static medical QA datasets into virtual patient profiles for multi-agent simulated conversation evaluation of LLMs
Multi-faceted CARE metric (accuracy, efficiency/strategy, empathy, robustness) with human expert validation of automated evaluation

screen.reason: The paper introduces AutoMedic, a multi-agent simulation framework to evaluate conversational LLMs in dynamic multi-turn interactions using virtual patient profiles and human-validated CARE metrics. It presents an evaluation methodology/benchmark rather than testing a specific health care organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
